Surabhi.note: Daughter of Daksha, wife of Kashyap; mother of cattle, the wish-granting cows.

Kamadhenu.note: The wish-fulfilling cow, daughter of Surabhi.

Nandini.note: Divine cow, daughter of Surabhi, kept by the sage Vasishtha.

rudraRaivata.name: Raivata
rudraRaivata.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraAja.name: Aja
rudraAja.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — 'the unborn', or 'the goat'. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraBhava.name: Bhava
rudraBhava.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — 'being', or 'becoming'. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraBhima.name: Bhima
rudraBhima.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — 'the terrible'. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraVama.name: Vama
rudraVama.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — 'the beautiful', and 'the contrary'. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraUgra.name: Ugra
rudraUgra.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — 'the fierce'. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraVrishakapi.name: Vrishakapi
rudraVrishakapi.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — the man-ape of RV 10.86, over whom Indra and Indrani quarrel. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraAjaikapat.name: Ajaikapat
rudraAjaikapat.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — 'the one-footed goat', a name the Rigveda keeps and does not explain. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraAhirbradhna.name: Ahirbradhna
rudraAhirbradhna.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — 'the serpent of the deep'. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraBahurupa.name: Bahurupa
rudraBahurupa.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — 'the many-formed'. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

rudraMahan.name: Mahan
rudraMahan.note: One of the eleven Rudras, sons of Kashyap by Daksha's daughter Surabhi — 'the great'. The Rudras are counted by name and never told apart: they are a class before they are eleven people, and the lists differ between the Puranas. SB 6.6.17-18

unions.note: Surabhi bore the cattle and, in the same list, the eleven Rudras. SB 6.6.17-18. The Puranas do not agree on the eleven names; this is the Bhagavata's own set.
